resources.string: Connect this phone to a Windows PC running Storage Service. Pairing does not sync or transfer files.
Couldn’t read the paired devices. Try refreshing the list before pairing again.
On the PC, open Storage Service and choose Add device. Use the hostname or IP address shown there. Both devices must be on the same local network.
Enter the Windows PC hostname or IP address.
On the PC, open Storage Service and choose Add Android phone. Point the camera at the QR code.
That isn’t a Storage pairing QR code.
The camera is unavailable. You can still enter the PC’s address manually.
Camera access wasn’t granted. You can still enter the PC’s address manually.
Check that this code matches the one shown by Storage Service on %1$s. Approve on both devices only if the codes match.
Pairing was declined. No trust was added by this attempt.
Couldn’t pair with the PC. Check the address, the local network, and the Add device screen on the PC.
Couldn’t pair with this QR code. Check the local network and request a new code on the PC.
Pairing could not be confirmed. Check the device lists on both devices before trying again.
